rules.observation: Closed 1H direction; only opposite 1H rearms; same direction repeat does not reset.
rules.entry: First strictly subsequent same-direction 15m closed Stoch arrow, model entry at that close.
rules.initial_stop: Latest 5 completed 5m candles including the 5m candle closing with entry; extreme plus 1 price point, rounded outward to tick.
rules.trail: 15m close reaches 5R; then close +/- 4 * 15m Wilder ATR(14); ratchet only; next 5m bar receives changed stop. No forced breakeven.
rules.active_beyond_display_limit: Still tracked until own exit; old closed records pruned.
